definitions.gloss: model sentence; sample text; example wording
definitions.explanation: An example sentence or sample passage provided as a model to follow, such as templates for letters, emails, or formal greetings.

examples.japanese: {文例|ぶんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: to use a model sentence for reference

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文例|ぶんれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: It contains many model sentences for letters.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}ったら→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{文例|ぶんれい}{集|しゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧みる。
examples.english: When I'm unsure how to word an email, I open a collection of model sentences.

notes:
A ready-made example sentence offered as a model, especially for correspondence and formal writing. Built from ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (sentence) and ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (example).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文例|ぶんれい}{集|しゅう}: a collection of model sentences
- {文例|ぶんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refer to a model sentence
- あいさつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文例|ぶんれい}: a model greeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{例文|れいぶん}→例文：19450_reibun⟧: example sentence — illustrates usage of a word or grammar point, not a template to copy
- ⟦{定型文|ていけいぶん}→定型文：15785_teikeibun⟧: fixed/boilerplate text — a set, reusable wording
